subject: How can I get the estimator of within-group variance in mixed effect model?

messages.author: c3bd29105a151028
messages.subject: How can I get the estimator of within-group variance in mixed effect model?
parts:
Dear All,

Suppose I have a latent model like this:

y_ik~N(mu_i, sigma^2_i)
mu_i~N(mu, v_i)
where i is the ith area (100 areas), k is the kth subject in area i.

I run the inla code as:
formula<- y ~ f(id,model = "iid") 
mod <- inla(formula, family = "gaussian", data = sample, control.predictor = list(compute = TRUE))

My question is how to estimate sigma^2_i in each area. (get 100 estimators) 
As the output has the component of "Fixed effects", "Precision for the Gaussian observations", and "Precision for id", I think sigma^2_i must be related with  "Precision for the Gaussian observations". But I don't know how to get it. Thanks in advance.

Best,
Jun
